## Hinweise zu Latex {.unnumbered}

The bibliography is generated from the cited BibTeX entries using the included IEEE CSL style. Bibliographic fields remain structured, so the output can differ from the cached Word entries. Word-specific author-name formatting errors are not deliberately copied into the BibTeX records.
